about.tagline: Since the beginning of my legal career, I have believed that every client is more than a case file — each one has a story of their own. From individual consultations to corporate legal matters, I work across a wide range of areas with transparent communication and meticulous discipline. My goal is to make complex legal processes understandable for my clients and to stand by them at every stage. The flexibility of working as an independent attorney allows me to give each case the time and attention it deserves. By continuously updating my knowledge, I stay quick to adapt to changes in legislation. My aim is to build long-term, trust-based attorney-client relationships.

practiceAreas.label: My Practice Areas
practiceAreas.heading: Tailored solutions for your legal needs
practiceAreas.subtitle: I provide professional legal support to my clients across a wide range of areas, particularly in criminal, family, labor, and commercial disputes.

ceza-hukuku.title: Criminal Law
ceza-hukuku.short: Effective defense during investigation and prosecution processes.
ceza-hukuku.description: Criminal law covers the investigation and prosecution processes that begin with an alleged offense, directly affecting personal liberty. Anyone involved in this process — as a suspect, defendant, or victim — needs qualified legal representation to protect their rights. I stand by you at every stage, from detention and questioning to the drafting of the indictment, hearings, and, if necessary, appellate proceedings, carefully preparing your defense strategy. I also handle technical matters such as judicial control, objections to detention, and mediation processes with an experienced approach. My goal is to safeguard your legal security at every stage and ensure a fair trial process.

aile-hukuku.title: Family Law
aile-hukuku.short: Legal support in divorce, custody, alimony, and family disputes.
aile-hukuku.description: Family law covers all legal matters arising from the formation of a marriage to its dissolution; divorce, custody, alimony, and division of marital property are among the main topics in this field. As these processes are often emotionally taxing, they require both legal knowledge and an empathetic approach. I work to best protect my clients' rights in contested and uncontested divorce cases, custody and visitation arrangements, and claims for spousal or child support. I also provide support with prenuptial and postnuptial agreements and protective measures for victims of domestic violence. My goal is to help you conclude these sensitive processes fairly and efficiently, with as little strain as possible.

icra-iflas-hukuku.title: Enforcement and Bankruptcy Law
icra-iflas-hukuku.short: Protecting your rights in debt collection, attachment, and bankruptcy processes.
icra-iflas-hukuku.description: Enforcement and bankruptcy law governs the processes through which creditors collect their claims and debtors restructure their debts within a legal framework. On the creditor side, I handle the initiation of enforcement proceedings, execution of attachments, and pursue the fastest possible collection of your claims. On the debtor side, I help minimize hardship through objection processes, payment plans, and solutions such as concordat. I also provide advisory services on bankruptcy postponement and restructuring for businesses facing financial difficulty. As matters in this area are subject to strict deadlines, swift and accurate legal intervention is essential.

is-hukuku.title: Labor and Social Security Law
is-hukuku.short: Advisory on employer-employee disputes as well as social security (SGK) matters.
is-hukuku.description: Labor and social security law is a broad field that addresses working life alongside the related social security rights. I provide advisory services and litigation support for both employees and employers in reinstatement cases, wrongful termination, severance and notice pay claims, and disputes over overtime and leave entitlements. I also handle compensation cases arising from workplace accidents and occupational illnesses, mobbing claims, and collective bargaining processes with an experienced approach. In addition, I provide support on social security-specific matters such as social security (SGK) procedures, insured status determination cases, disability/old-age/survivor's pension claims, and service determination lawsuits. For employers, I offer advisory services on drafting employment contracts and internal policies in compliance with legislation. My goal is to protect your rights in both your working life and your social security processes through a proactive legal approach.

ticaret-hukuku.title: Commercial Law
ticaret-hukuku.short: Legal support in corporate matters, commercial contracts, and disputes.
ticaret-hukuku.description: Commercial law covers the entire legal lifecycle of a business, from incorporation and day-to-day operations to partnership relations and dispute resolution. I provide advisory services on structural matters such as company formation, drafting articles of association, and partnership or shareholder agreements. I work to minimize your business's legal risks in the drafting and negotiation of commercial contracts, supply and distribution relationships, and competition law compliance. I also offer effective litigation support in disputes between partners, debt collection cases, and disputes arising from commercial contracts. My goal is to ensure your commercial activities proceed on a solid, predictable, and secure legal foundation.

gayrimenkul-hukuku.title: Real Estate Law
gayrimenkul-hukuku.short: Advisory on title deeds, leases, condominium ownership, and property disputes.
gayrimenkul-hukuku.description: Real estate law covers a broad range of matters, from acquiring and leasing property to zoning processes and dispute resolution. I protect my clients' rights in title deed cancellation and registration cases, as well as in claims for expropriation compensation and de facto expropriation. I also provide legal support in eviction and rent disputes arising from lease agreements, and in conflicts stemming from condominium ownership and management plans. I offer advisory services in drafting contracts and safely conducting title deed transactions during property purchase and sale processes. My goal is to give you all the information and support you need to make your real estate investment decisions on solid legal ground.

miras-hukuku.title: Inheritance Law
miras-hukuku.short: Legal support in estate distribution, wills, and inheritance disputes.
miras-hukuku.description: Inheritance law governs how a deceased person's estate is distributed among heirs — a field that often involves sensitive family dynamics. I guide my clients through obtaining certificates of inheritance, renunciation of inheritance, and heirship documentation processes. I work diligently to protect your rights in estate distribution disputes, claims of asset concealment from heirs, and reduction (tenkis) lawsuits. I also provide advisory services on preventive legal tools such as drafting wills and inheritance agreements. Recognizing that inheritance matters often involve delicate family dynamics, I work toward a fair outcome with both a legal and a human approach.

sozlesmeler-hukuku.title: Contract Law
sozlesmeler-hukuku.short: Professional support in drafting and reviewing all types of contracts.
sozlesmeler-hukuku.description: Contract law governs the rights and obligations between parties, forming the foundation of both commercial and personal relationships. I provide support in drafting and reviewing a wide range of contracts, including lease, sale, service, consulting, and partnership agreements. I carefully assess whether an existing contract adequately protects your rights, identify potential risks, and make necessary revisions. I also handle compensation and debt collection cases arising from contract disputes, termination, or non-performance. My aim is to ensure every contract is clear, balanced, and legally sound from the moment it is signed, protecting you throughout its duration.

tuketici-hukuku.title: Consumer Law
tuketici-hukuku.short: Advisory on defective goods/services, right of withdrawal, and consumer disputes.
tuketici-hukuku.description: Consumer law aims to protect the rights of individuals who purchase goods or services — one of the most commonly encountered areas of law in daily life. I work to protect my clients' rights in claims arising from defective goods and services, the exercise of the right of withdrawal, and disputes arising from doorstep sales and distance contracts. I provide effective representation before consumer arbitration committees and consumer courts. I also offer advisory services on disputes arising from subscription agreements, credit card, and banking transactions. My goal is to ensure consumers can fully exercise their rights against the stronger party (seller/provider).

milletlerarasi-ozel-hukuk.title: Private International Law
milletlerarasi-ozel-hukuk.short: Legal advisory and representation in disputes involving a foreign element.
milletlerarasi-ozel-hukuk.description: Private international law is a specialized field governing legal relationships in which at least one party is foreign, or the matter otherwise involves a foreign element. I provide advisory and representation services in the recognition and enforcement of foreign court judgments, international family law disputes, and inheritance and commercial cases involving a foreign element. I handle technical matters such as determining the applicable law and the competent court with an experienced approach. I also support Turkish citizens living abroad and foreign nationals in Turkey in their legal processes. My goal is to ensure your rights are fully protected even in cross-border legal matters.

tazminat-hukuku.title: Tort and Compensation Law
tazminat-hukuku.short: Pursuing your rights and claims in material and moral compensation cases.
tazminat-hukuku.description: Tort and compensation law concerns the remedy of damages suffered by a person due to a wrongful act or breach of contract. I pursue my clients' rights in material and moral compensation cases arising from traffic accidents, workplace accidents, medical malpractice, and other wrongful acts. I work meticulously in determining the damage, establishing the degree of fault, and calculating the compensation amount. I also provide effective representation in disputes with insurance companies. My goal is to help you obtain the fairest possible legal remedy for the material and moral loss you have suffered.

fikri-mulkiyet-hukuku.title: Intellectual Property Law
fikri-mulkiyet-hukuku.short: Advisory on protecting trademarks, patents, designs, and copyrights.
fikri-mulkiyet-hukuku.description: Intellectual property law, an increasingly important field today, concerns the protection of intangible assets such as trademarks, patents, designs, and copyrights. I provide advisory services during trademark and patent registration processes and representation in trademark infringement and unfair competition cases. I also support rights holders in copyright infringement matters and in drafting licensing agreements. I offer preventive legal advisory services to entrepreneurs and content creators to protect their intellectual property assets. My goal is to ensure your creative and innovative work is legally safeguarded.

bilisim-hukuku.title: Information Technology Law
bilisim-hukuku.short: Support in data protection, cybersecurity, and digital platform disputes.
bilisim-hukuku.description: Information technology law, growing in importance alongside rapid technological development, covers personal data protection, cybercrimes, and disputes arising from digital platforms. I provide advisory services on data protection compliance processes and personal data protection matters. I offer support in legal processes related to cyber fraud, identity theft, and crimes committed in digital environments. I provide contract and compliance advisory services for e-commerce platforms and digital service providers. My goal is to safeguard you against the legal risks you may encounter in the digital world.
